news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a pre-NDA meeting with the FDA that yielded constructive feedback and alignment on the planned content and format of its New Drug Application for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis. The company confirmed it remains on track to submit the NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132
news.summary: Morgan Stanley raised its 12-month price target on Abivax to $180 from $132 while maintaining an Overweight rating, citing continued confidence following the ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 safety data. The move joined a wave of analyst price-target increases across multiple firms.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax added four executives to its Commercial Leadership Team spanning marketing, patient services, sales and market access, including a former Amgen TEZSPIRE franchise head with prior Entyvio launch experience at Takeda. The hires build out the infrastructure for a potential US commercial launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax's $920 Million Cash Haul Lets It Prepare for Solo US Launch Instead of Relying on a Buyer, CEO Tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC the freshly raised $920 million gives Abivax the option to launch obefazimod in the US on its own rather than needing a Big Pharma partner or acquirer, amid persistent takeover speculation around the company.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed an underwritten public offering of ADSs, including full exercise of the underwriters' option, for gross proceeds of approximately $920 million. The financing substantially extends the company's cash runway to fund a potential US launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax Reports Positive ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Results for Obefazimod in Refractory Ulcerative Colitis Patients
news.summary: Supplemental Phase 3 data showed obefazimod produced meaningful clinical and endoscopic remission (37.2% of prior non-responders reached remission) in a highly refractory UC population, and dose escalation to 50mg recaptured remission in 45.5% of relapsed patients. Malignancy rates across the expanded safety database were consistent with background rates in UC patients, easing the cancer-signal concerns raised by earlier maintenance data.

catalysts.label: US FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA on July 30, Abivax remains on track to file its New Drug Application in Q4 2026, based on the completed ABTECT Phase 3 induction and maintenance dataset.

catalysts.label: EMA MAA filing for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for a Marketing Authorization Application submission to the European Medicines Agency in the second half of 2026, contingent on the positive maintenance data already reported.

catalysts.label: Crohn's disease Phase 2b (ENHANCE-CD) induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the 12-week induction portion of the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease are expected, informing design of subsequent registrational studies.

catalysts.label: FDA decision / potential US approval and commercial launch
catalysts.detail: Assuming NDA acceptance after the planned year-end 2026 submission and a standard review cycle, an FDA action date would likely fall in 2027; Abivax has already begun building a commercial organization and has cash guided into 2029 to support a potential solo US launch.

pulse: Abivax has had a strong run since late June: after an early-June scare over cancer cases in the high-dose maintenance arm sent shares crashing, follow-up Part 2 data on June 29 showed malignancy rates in line with UC background rates, and the stock has since rallied on a $920M capital raise (closed July 6), new commercial leadership hires (July 23), and a positive FDA pre-NDA meeting (July 30) that keeps the company on track for a year-end 2026 NDA filing. Analysts including Morgan Stanley have raised price targets, reflecting growing confidence that Abivax can pursue an independent US launch of obefazimod rather than seeking a buyer. The key catalysts ahead for the long call position are the actual FDA/EMA filings before year-end 2026 and the eventual approval decision expected in 2027.
